purpose: GoPro H9-13 waterproof housing as Boat Puck enclosure
doctrine: Housing cavity = camera positive (mold clearance microns only)

cavity.source: GoPro HERO9-13 product Design+Dimensions (shared chassis); includes mounting-finger form factor
cavity.mold_clearance_note: Housing is molded to this positive; typical polycarbonate snap clearance is microns to ~0.1 mm — treat cavity = camera for electronics packing

camera_positive_alt_community_rounded.source: Older GoPro community size articles — do not use for packing; superseded by 71.8 x 50.8 x 33.6 product specs

insert_design_solid.note: Outer envelope of Boat Puck = camera positive. Optional print slip (e.g. -0.15 mm/side) is manufacturing tolerance only, not cavity uncertainty.

keepouts_from_camera_geometry.lens_barrel_and_cover_glass: front centre — part of positive; leave void or blank the glass
keepouts_from_camera_geometry.folding_mount_fingers: bottom — housing has finger wells; reclaim if insert has no fingers
keepouts_from_camera_geometry.button_faces: top shutter / side mode — plunger pads in housing
keepouts_from_camera_geometry.battery_door_side: side door geometry on camera — housing follows it
keepouts_from_camera_geometry.rear_screen_plane: flat to backdoor; O-ring on housing door
